table.name: resource_alert_events
table.comment: Alertmanager 告警和 Kubernetes Event 的统一记录

column.name: source
column.comment: alertmanager 或 kubernetes

column.name: external_id
column.comment: Alertmanager fingerprint 或 Kubernetes Event metadata.uid

column.name: object_type
column.comment: Kubernetes involvedObject.kind，如 Pod、Node、Job；Alertmanager 从标签推断

column.name: object_name
column.comment: 对象名称

column.name: namespace
column.comment: 对象所属命名空间；Node 等集群级对象为空

column.name: object_uid
column.comment: Kubernetes involvedObject.uid；区分同名对象重建

column.name: object_api_version
column.comment: Kubernetes involvedObject.apiVersion；区分相同 Kind 的不同 API 组

column.name: description
column.comment: Alertmanager 注释描述或 Kubernetes Event message

column.name: severity
column.comment: Alertmanager severity；Kubernetes Warning 对应 warning、Normal 对应 info

column.name: occurred_at
column.comment: 告警 startsAt 或 Event 首次发生时间

column.name: alert_type
column.comment: Alertmanager alertname 或 Kubernetes Event reason

column.name: summary
column.comment: Alertmanager annotations.summary

column.name: labels
column.comment: Alertmanager 原始 labels

column.name: annotations
column.comment: Alertmanager 原始 annotations

column.name: generator_url
column.comment: Alertmanager generatorURL

column.name: ends_at
column.comment: Alertmanager endsAt

column.name: webhook_context
column.comment: Alertmanager webhook 中除 alerts 外的顶层字段

column.name: event_type
column.comment: Kubernetes Event type 原值，如 Warning 或 Normal

column.name: event_count
column.comment: Kubernetes Event 累计发生次数

column.name: source_component
column.comment: Kubernetes Event 报告组件，不等于 source

column.name: source_host
column.comment: Kubernetes Event 报告主机

column.name: last_seen_at
column.comment: Kubernetes Event 最近一次发生时间

column.name: raw_payload
column.comment: 完整 Alertmanager 单条告警或 Kubernetes core/v1 Event

column.name: updated_at
column.comment: 本服务最近一次接收或同步时间

column.name: resolution_status
column.comment: 告警解决状态：active 或 resolved

column.name: resolution_source
column.comment: 解决来源：alertmanager、automatic 或 manual

column.name: resolved_at
column.comment: 标记解决的时间

statement.sql: ALTER TABLE resource_alert_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resolution_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
ALTER TABLE resource_alert_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resolution_source text
ALTER TABLE resource_alert_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resolved_at timestamptz
